Quoted on Friday, Done by Half 11 on Tuesday

Fixed leaking decommissioned chimney and repointed ridge tiles

Had a great experience - they came and did a quote the same day. Quoted me on Friday and fit me in on the following Tuesday. The workmen that came to do the job were great - arrived at 9am and were finished by half 11. Fantastic price, fantastic work and a 10 year guarantee, couldn't ask for better!

Nikki M, Hull (HU3). Checkatrade review, 18 February 2026

Roof repairs and Dry Verge

Original work that needed doing was having a dry verge on. When the team arrived to do that they realised a lot of work needed doing on the roof before the dry verge could be done. The timescale to do it was brilliant, they got all the work done in one day and we couldn't be happier with the lads who did it.

Joshua L, Hull (HU3). Checkatrade review, 21 September 2026

Excellent, clean and efficient.

We were looking for a roofer to complete some work for us. We had a quote from a local roofer but let us down. We were travelling in our car when we saw the smart call roofcare van and I called the freephone number on their van and arranged a quote. Initially, we thought it was just the guttering that needed renewing then discovered all of the facia had rotted and needed renewing. We received a quote from the photographic and physical evidence that John provided and agreed for the work to go ahead. John and his crew were very clean, and efficient and would recommend them.

Verified Checkatrade customer, Hull (HU4). Checkatrade review, 2 February 2026
